narrative.overview: A simple, clean native macOS workbench. Terminals own the visual field; system controls and compact navigation make sessions easy to reach. SwiftUI and AppKit supply dynamic colors, system typography and familiar keyboard behavior. The original ivory H-shaped herd animal on charcoal remains the app identity.
keyCharacteristics: Appearance-aware system surfaces and accent selection.
Familiar native controls, SF Symbols and keyboard access.
Flat navigation with clear selected-space and focused-pane states.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Keep chrome bound to platform semantic colors. Do not freeze a screenshot appearance into a new palette.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve terminal legibility and native text metrics; truncate long navigation labels instead of shrinking their type.

dos: Do use semantic system colors and verify both macOS appearances.
Do keep terminal content dominant and controls compact.
Do pair status color with readable text and preserve native keyboard focus.
Do retain the recognizable original app icon.
donts: Don’t replace native controls with a web-style component theme.
Don’t invent fixed equivalents for dynamic colors or platform text styles.
Don’t add decorative shadows, oversized branding or card chrome around terminal panes.
Don’t hide long labels behind controls; retain truncation and tooltips.
